body:
Today's scan turned up zero cross-platform arbitrage opportunities, and that's an unremarkable result rather than a gap in coverage — with 71 live contracts across the two venues, most of the pricing lines up sensibly with where gold actually sits right now. Spot has been running near $4,397 as of Tuesday morning per Fortune's tracker. Gold was trading at $4,397 per ounce at 8:50 a.m. Eastern Time today, continuing a rally that had gold a $13 gain from yesterday at the same hour and $1,054 higher than a year ago. A day earlier, Monday's open showed a 2.4% weekly gain at the open, with weakness in the U.S. dollar and in recent economic data contributing. That backdrop explains why Kalshi's ladder of settlement strikes is clustered so high: the $4,331.99 above strike for August 31 is pricing near even money (bid 0.47/ask 0.55), which is exactly where you'd expect it with spot already at $4,397.

The reason a scan can find nothing despite dozens of contracts is mostly mechanics. Kalshi's markets are settlement contracts — they pay out based on the official gold price at one fixed moment (5:00 PM EDT on August 31, or year-end). Polymarket's contracts are mostly touch markets that pay out if gold hits a level at any point during a window, which is a materially easier bar to clear than a single-moment settlement. So even when strikes look similar — Kalshi's August 31 $4,331.99 line versus Polymarket's weekly $4,300 touch-low (63–69%) — they aren't really pricing the same event, and any apparent gap reflects that rule difference rather than free money.

Liquidity is also thin at the edges: many of the far out-of-the-money Kalshi strikes (above $4,571.99 and higher) show zero 24-hour volume, and several Polymarket touch markets trade only single-digit dollars a day. Thin, stale books like these are a common source of phantom edges that vanish once you try to actually fill them. Overall, a quiet day: elevated gold, no dislocations worth flagging.
headline: No cross-platform gold arbitrage found as Kalshi and Polymarket prices track $4,397 spot
